accountabilities.detail: Develop audit plans, including determining audit objectives, scope, and methodologies. Conduct audits by gathering and analyzing data, examining financial statements, assessing internal controls, and testing compliance with policies and regulations.

competencies.description: A strong understanding of auditing principles, practices, and methodologies is essential. This includes knowledge of internal control frameworks, risk assessment techniques, and generally accepted auditing standards (GAAS).

Internal auditors should have a good understanding of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards to ensure compliance. This includes knowledge of financial reporting regulations, data privacy laws, and industry-specific compliance requirements.

accountabilities.detail: Developing and implementing maintenance plans and strategies to ensure the effective and efficient maintenance of equipment, machinery, and facilities. This includes determining maintenance requirements, setting maintenance priorities, and establishing maintenance schedules.

Overseeing preventive maintenance activities to minimize equipment failures and breakdowns. This involves creating preventive maintenance schedules, conducting inspections, and ensuring timely servicing. Additionally, managing corrective maintenance by addressing breakdowns or malfunctions promptly and effectively.

Managing the organization's equipment and facilities to ensure proper functioning and optimal utilization. This includes conducting regular equipment inspections, coordinating repairs and replacements, and implementing asset management strategies.

Collaborating with the management team to develop maintenance budgets and effectively allocate resources. This includes estimating costs, tracking expenditures, optimizing resource utilization, and making informed decisions to balance maintenance needs with financial constraints

Managing relationships with external vendors, contractors, and service providers. This involves sourcing and selecting vendors, negotiating contracts, monitoring performance, and ensuring the timely and cost-effective delivery of maintenance services.

Managing the organization's assets throughout their lifecycle. This involves developing asset management strategies, conducting regular inspections, implementing maintenance plans, and making informed decisions regarding repair, replacement, or disposal of assets.

Maintaining accurate records and preparing reports related to maintenance activities, expenses, equipment history, and performance metrics. This includes providing regular updates to management on maintenance performance, identifying trends, and highlighting areas for improvement.

The ability to identify and solve maintenance-related problems is vital. This involves analyzing issues, evaluating alternatives, and implementing effective solutions in a timely manner to minimize downtime and maximize equipment reliability.

accountabilities.detail: Your primary responsibility is to collect data from various sources within the food industry. This includes production processes, quality control checkpoints, inventory systems, supplier information, customer feedback, and other relevant areas. You must ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data collection.

Accurately enter collected data into designated databases, spreadsheets, or information systems. Follow established protocols and guidelines for data entry to maintain data integrity. Maintain appropriate documentation, such as data collection forms, logbooks, or records, to ensure traceability and auditability.

Verify the accuracy and consistency of collected data through validation and quality control procedures. Conduct checks and audits to identify and resolve any discrepancies or errors. Collaborate with quality control teams to ensure data meets the required quality standards.

Collaborate with data analysts or other stakeholders to provide support for data analysis activities. Assist in data preparation, cleaning, and transformation to ensure data is in a suitable format for analysis. Contribute to generating basic reports or visualizations based on collected data.

Organize and manage collected data in a structured and accessible manner. Develop and maintain data organization practices, including naming conventions, folder structures, and version control. Ensure data is properly stored, archived, and secured.

competencies.description: Familiarity with various data collection methods, such as manual data entry, automated data capture tools, and sensor technologies. Understanding when and how to use different methods based on the nature of the data and the specific requirements of the food industry.

Strong attention to detail is essential for accurate data collection. Being meticulous in capturing data, verifying information, and detecting any errors or inconsistencies. Paying close attention to ensure data accuracy and completeness.

Competence in managing data, including organizing, storing, and maintaining data integrity. Familiarity with data management practices, such as data entry protocols, data validation techniques, and documentation standards.
Understanding data validation methods and quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy and consistency of collected data. Ability to identify and address data discrepancies, errors, or outliers.

Strong problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues related to data collection. Ability to troubleshoot data collection challenges, address technical issues, and find solutions to improve data collection processes.

A willingness to learn and stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies related to data collection. Being proactive in seeking opportunities for professional development and acquiring new skills.
